propositions: Canonical contributor guidance hardcodes a specific bot identity (Joe Oakhart <joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com>) instead of instructing contributors to use their own configured git identity.

Documentation files AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/rebar.md, and CONTRIBUTING.md contain contradictory sign-off instructions: some prescribe a specific bot identity while policy requires real contributor names and emails.
A deterministic consistency check must be added to the build (make lint) to detect and reject reintroduction of hardcoded personal sign-off identities in contributor-facing documentation.

Joe Oakhart's bot identity should be retained only in narrowly scoped automation files (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/fixtures/) and experiment corpora, explicitly excluded from the consistency check.
